notes.title: Update 1.1.00
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]

[list]

[*] New hiding spots added on emptier sections of the map.

[*] New shortcuts have been added to cut down backtracking.

[*] Power boxes now have an audio cue to indicate one is nearby.

[*] Gates stay open forever, allowing you to always use unlocked shortcuts, even after dying.

[*] The audio cues of the car have less echo, making it easier to pinpoint where the car is at.

[*] Roadmaps have lights above them to make them easier to spot.

[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue in a hidden scene where the next scene would not load.

[*] Fixed a visual error on the main menu.

[/list]
